frozen_inputs.sampler: identical natural trajectory chunks plus identical event-stratified windows

arms.name: no_state_context
arms.contract: the physical-state channel is always zero

arms.name: initial_state_only
arms.contract: true normalized state enters once at the first burn-in step and is zero thereafter

arms.name: predicted_state_feedback
arms.contract: the same true initial state enters once, followed only by the model's own previous normalized prediction

causal_control.parameter_modules: identical Linear + SiLU + standard GRUCell + LayerNorm/Linear/SiLU/Linear decoder

secondary_metrics: validation mean and worst state NRMSE

preflight_success_rule.event_requirement: predicted feedback produces at least one matched validation spike and improves event soma RMSE by at least 20 percent versus initial_state_only
preflight_success_rule.guardrails: mean, slow, synaptic and subthreshold errors are each no worse than 110 percent of initial_state_only
preflight_success_rule.replication: success authorizes a fresh three-seed capacity-matched replication; it is not itself a scientific claim

failure_rules: zero matched spikes and less than 10 percent event-RMSE improvement closes direct predicted-state feedback as an immediate remedy
event improvement with any common-regime guardrail above 110 percent is a trade-off and does not promote
an initialization-only gain without an additional feedback gain supports initial observability, not recursive feedback
guardrails: teacher state enters at most once per complete trajectory
stratified-window context is replayed from the true trajectory beginning rather than initialized from a teacher state at the window boundary
no loss, optimizer, sampler, width or update-count change across arms
checkpoint selection uses validation event soma RMSE only
